## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated for new logic
- [ ] UI strings go through i18n, with Spanish and English in sync
- [ ] Docs updated if behaviour changed (`README.md`, `docs/mcp.md`, `docs/deploy.md`)
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or personal data in code, fixtures or screenshots
